title: Three species at once: equilateral A-B-C triangle, side 5, at rest, T = 2
pitch: One run with A, B and C at the vertices of an equilateral triangle of side 5.0 (inside every current claim's pair range), at rest, observed for T = 2. Each vertex has two cross-species neighbours, so this tests whether the cross-species pair laws add with no three-body term when all three species interact at once. Prediction (lab-c, before the result): the pairwise sum of the species-matched pair tables fits to judged RMSE/L below 0.01. A failure above 0.02 would show a three-body or species-coupling term that no current claim covers. Single run, tracker only.
